verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's own conditional-access page says access is revoked when a device falls out of compliance or the user is off a trusted network. Its SSO page describes passwordless login from managed devices, and its MDM manages endpoints across operating systems, so device-compliance-gated access is a first-party capability. However, the evidence is marketing copy only and never names the posture attributes or shows a pre-session policy check. missing for 10: documented posture checks for disk encryption and screen lock, evidence that posture is evaluated in the auth policy before an app session is granted (rather than only revoking access), in-depth policy configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
